characters.description: Commander of the Ankh-Morpork City Watch and Duke of Ankh, a blunt, working-class copper who dislikes his own title and distrusts diplomacy. Lord Vetinari sends him abroad as an ambassador to the distant, dangerous country of Uberwald, a role he is spectacularly unsuited for and which he treats, at heart, as police work.
characters.name: Sam Vimes

characters.description: Vimes's wife, a large, warm, immensely capable aristocrat and famous breeder of swamp dragons. Well-connected and unflappable, she accompanies Vimes on his diplomatic mission and handles the social side of it far more gracefully than he does.
characters.name: Sybil Vimes

characters.description: A very tall man raised by dwarfs and a captain of the City Watch, honest and literal-minded, with a natural gift for leadership. He is romantically attached to the werewolf Angua.
characters.name: Carrot Ironfoundersson

characters.description: A sergeant of the City Watch and a werewolf, originally from an aristocratic werewolf family in Uberwald that she left behind. Capable and self-controlled, she is uneasy about the prospect of her homeland and her relatives re-entering her life.
characters.name: Angua von Uberwald

characters.description: A dwarf member of the Watch who works on forensic detection and who, unusually for a dwarf, openly presents as female. Precise and clever, she travels with Vimes into dwarf country, where such openness is provocative.
characters.name: Cheery Littlebottom

characters.description: A stout, cautious sergeant of the Watch who is left in charge of policing Ankh-Morpork while his superiors are abroad, a responsibility that quickly reveals the limits of his leadership.
characters.name: Fred Colon

characters.description: A scruffy, opportunistic corporal of the Watch of dubious pedigree, who carries a document certifying that he is human. He remains behind in the city with the skeleton Watch.
characters.name: Nobby Nobbs

characters.description: A troll sergeant of the City Watch, hugely strong and slower-witted in the heat, who accompanies Vimes on the journey to Uberwald as bodyguard and muscle.
characters.name: Detritus

characters.description: A scruffy, disreputable Ankh-Morpork street dog who can talk, a fact he keeps quiet. Cynical and streetwise, he attaches himself to the story as it moves and offers unsolicited canine commentary.
characters.name: Gaspode

characters.description: The dwarf about to be crowned ruler of the dwarfs at a grand coronation in Uberwald, a moment of high political tension. The ceremony depends on an ancient dwarf artefact of deep symbolic importance.
characters.name: The Low King

characters.description: Angua's brother, a powerful and aggressive werewolf of the Uberwald aristocracy who leads his family's clan. Physically imposing and openly contemptuous of weakness, he treats hunting and dominance as sport.
characters.name: Wolfgang von Uberwald

characters.description: A servant of the traditional Uberwald type, an Igor: lisping, scarred, endlessly helpful, and a master of surgery and stitchwork. He is assigned to assist Vimes at the embassy.
characters.name: Igor
